title: Terra Mage weapon wheel with locked unarmed slot
request: Implement a weapon wheel for the real Terra Mage Unity project. Open the wheel when holding Tab. Maximum total slots is 10. Slot 0 must always be locked to bare hands and bare hands must be able to punch. The player must be able to assign weapons into the remaining wheel slots. If the wheel has fewer than 10 assigned entries, do not leave empty arc gaps. Instead, divide the full circle evenly across only the active assigned entries. Example: bare hands only plus 1 assigned weapon = 2 equal left/right halves. Bare hands plus 2 assigned weapons = 3 equal segments. Continue scaling this way up to 10 total active slots. Integrate this as real implementation, not prototype only.
